answer_1.quote: In this paper, we improve unsupervised attribute transfer by enforcing invariances via explicit constraints.

answer_2.quote: Our automatic evaluation considers the following three prominent criteria: i) Semantic Similarity (SIM)... ii) Transfer Accuracy (ACC)... iii) Fluency (FL)...

answer_4.quote: We also perform an indicative human evaluation where we randomly sample 100 samples from each of the three datasets and hire three researchers to rate every sentence for FL, SIM and ACC on a 3-point scale.
